sections.title: implementation-contract.v1.json

sections.title: repair/round-1/finding-set.md
sections.content: Scopes repair to coordinator trust, terminal bindings, traceability, authority declarations, immutable historical-plan protection, and RED-baseline contamination. Notes pre-existing workflow changes and absent repair closure.

sections.title: requirements-and-acceptance.md
sections.content: Requires trusted persisted coordinator evidence, reentrant successor recovery, authorization continuity, degraded same-selection knowledge refresh, legacy RED compatibility, and read-only historical dogfood replay. No publication or lifecycle authorization is granted.

sections.title: tools/terminal_full.py
sections.content: Validates plan authority, maintainer authorization, knowledge context and freeze integrity, skill-input receipt, terminal receipts, registered commands, selectors, candidate binding, and final bindings. Reports pass/fail with authorizes empty.
